directive.quote: Then add a check row so this cannot recur: a commit in trillion, trillion-rust, trillion-workshop or trillion-apps that deletes a source or test file must name its new home (a moved-from receipt) or a retirement decision; write it as a record:check row through the Workshop check tools (the judge reads check rows; do not write hook code), with a test.

job: refuse a commit or push that deletes a source or test file without naming its new home or the decision that retired it
banned_substitutions: a hook script in a repository's .claude folder
a second reading of what a git command publishes

distinct_from.why: judges feature files a change adds or grows against port contracts; it reads no deletion. Its spanForCommand is imported, not copied.
runs the person's check rows; it judges nothing itself.
moves files and writes the moved-from receipts this judge reads; it does not refuse a deletion made without it.
its gate refuses a deletion of a retired path whose tag does not hold the file; it does not judge deletions of paths no row names.
This tool itself: its README, part, check row, rules, rows and test name this judge and call judgeDeletions.
This tool's own capability row, whose owner names this folder: the registry entry for this tool, not another owner of the job.
The generated tool catalog (publish-tool-catalog.mjs): it carries this tool's own row. A generated listing of this tool, not another owner of the job.
A report of old trillion's deleted files this tool still finds no home for, read out of this tool's answers; data about the job's findings, not code that judges.
